messages:
vivian: Morning — kicking off slowstart for the surge_guard feature flag. rolling to 2% in prod now. TL;DR: watch error rates and queue depth, ops will hold if p50 latency > 400ms.

samir: ack. checked infra autoscaler; CPU headroom looks fine. any specific metric to watch?

vivian: prioritize inference/token-latency.p50, queue.size and fallback.rate. we'll annotate thresholds in the runbook.

pm-kate: quick Q: does this affect Dedicated customers? we promised no evictions.

elaine: Not for Dedicated. surge_guard only on hosted route /v1/generate. Dedicated stays on pinned model.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: feature-flag "surge_guard_slowstart" set to 2% via flags-service. rollout id: sg-20260317-01.

josh: pinging owners on observability — pushing a temporary dashboard and alert for p50>400ms and fallback.rate>0.5% in the next 5m.

vivian: thanks. I'll run a couple of synthetic requests against new path to prime caches.

samir: saw a small uptick in KV-store latency around the 2:10PM window (trace id 0x4f2a). could be cold KV shards. might stabilize.

elaine: blocker: we have an outstanding approval on the rate-limit bypass PR — if rate-limit rules reject synthetic priming, priming won't work. @vivian can you confirm PR #4823 is merged?

vivian: merged 18m ago. priming works. snippet I used:
```bash
for i in {1..50}; do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
 -d '{"model":"redwood-1-small","input":"prime"}' https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate >/dev/null; done
```

pm-kate: heads-up: billing team wants to know if we flip guard to 100% will it affect cost projections. short answer?

josh: if on-hosted we expect ~2–3% token cost increase at 100% because of extra caching layers; at 2% negligible. will provide numbers by EOD.

vivian: ops-bot reports rollout health: CPU, errors, latency all nominal at 2% after 10m. continuing ramp to 10% in 20m if no regressions.

ops-bot: Rollout monitor: sg-20260317-01: 2% -> 2% (10m). alerts: 0. next scheduled step: 10% in 20m.

samir: small note — we should keep an eye on fallback-rate per region; eu-west-1 was 0.07% vs us-west-2 0.0%. may be noisy.

elaine: noted. i'll pause any further regional ramps until we confirm KV rebalancing finished.

vivian: next steps: I'll post another update before the 10% ramp. If anyone sees p50>400ms or fallback.rate>0.2% call it out here and we abort.

josh: ack. will post the dashboard link once ready.

pm-kate: thanks team. no blockers from product side.
